description: IceRPC is an RPC framework for C# and .NET that runs over QUIC or TCP, with RPCs defined in Slice or Protobuf.
rules: IceRPC and Ice are separate frameworks with different APIs: don't use Ice docs or samples for IceRPC code.
Add IceRPC to a project through NuGet: IceRpc.Slice and IceRpc.Slice.Tools for Slice, or IceRpc.Protobuf and IceRpc.Protobuf.Tools for Protobuf.
